hero.description:
Computer Science Engineer and recent EPN graduate with two years of hands-on production experience at Wanqara. I have developed frontend modules using Vue.js and taken ownership of the E2E testing suite with Playwright, focusing on software quality, stability, and reliability.

I incorporate AI and automation tools such as MCP, Rules, Skills, and Gemini into my development workflow to accelerate research, debugging, and problem-solving while maintaining full technical ownership and independent decision-making.

My focus is on building robust, maintainable, production-ready interfaces, combining frontend development, test automation, and solid engineering practices to deliver reliable software.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I’m a Computer Science Engineer and recent graduate of EPN, with two years of professional experience at Wanqara working with software in production. My experience has primarily focused on frontend development with Vue.js and software quality through E2E automation with Playwright, CI pipelines using GitHub Actions, and resolving concurrency issues across different environments.
about.p2: For my thesis, I developed an academic assistant based on a RAG architecture, deployed on Linux with Nginx and SSL. I chose this approach because institutional regulations can change frequently, making a retrieval-based architecture a practical way to keep the knowledge base up to date without retraining the model. I used Qdrant for embedding storage and retrieval, complemented by Redis for caching.
about.p3: I’m looking to continue growing in roles where I can combine frontend development, automation, and software quality from the early stages of the development lifecycle. I incorporate AI tools and autonomous agents into my workflow to accelerate research, debugging, and problem-solving while maintaining technical judgment, autonomy, and strong software engineering fundamentals.
